verdict.rationale: Founder Law documents employer-side sponsorship as a service. It handles H-1B, L-1, and employment-based visas "to hire and retain global teams" and helps "specialty workers and their employers" with H-1B transfers and the lottery process. Its corporate immigration page adds extensions, amendments, and client-site H-1Bs, and its flat-fee packages cover H-1B petitions and transfers. Missing for 10: any mention of LCA preparation or compliance, explicit detail on H-1B registration filing and employer paperwork such as public access files, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
